tagline: 玛米亚取景器相机，1979 年发布
description: 玛米亚于1979年推出的取景器相机。配备Mamiya-Sekor 38mm f/2.8.。快门速度1/25 - 1/60 - 1/250s.。

specs.英文简介: Produced in 1979 for Mamiya (possibly by Konica) as an attempt to get a piece of the point and shoot compact camera market, the 135EF is a zone-focus film camera that is effectively an update of the Mamiya 135 rangefinder.
